description.default: Drag Markdown files, folders or ZIP archives from the file manager onto the document tree to import them, keeping the folder hierarchy. Local images and files (PDF, Word…) are uploaded automatically, including Obsidian ![[...]] embeds.
description.zh-CN: 把 Markdown 文件、文件夹、压缩包从资源管理器直接拖到文档树导入，层级原样还原。正文里的图片、PDF 等本地文件自动上传并改写链接，Obsidian 的 ![[...]] 写法也认。
